<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral expansion:</strong> Parliament is set to vote on a significant bill that would reshape India’s electoral map by increasing the number of Lok Sabha seats from 543 to 850.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative agenda:</strong> As the Monsoon Session enters its final week, the Rajya Sabha is scheduled to deliberate on the Taxation Laws Amendment Bill and the Bankers&#x27; Books Evidence Bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political instability:</strong> Internal cabinet issues have reportedly pushed the Congress party into a state of political turmoil.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
</ul>
